simple.meaning: גַּם (gam) appears 769 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with flocks. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering from the firstborn of the flock and its fat and divine acceptance.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 3:6. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, family line, flock, offering, firstborn.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גַּם (H1571) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows גַּם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: גַּם (gam) / H1571 is tracked through Genesis 3:6, Genesis 3:22, Genesis 4:4, Genesis 4:22. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H1571. gam גַּם 768 adverb denoting addition , also, moreover, yea (Moabite id. , also Zinjirli (Lzb 250 Cooke 166 ); probably akin to √ ; compare (accusative) in a mass, altogether ) — 1 also, moreover , emphasizing sometimes the thought of an entire sentence, but more usually the word immediately following, as Gen 3:6 לְאִישָׁהּ גַּם וַתִּתֵּן and gave also to her husband, Genesis 3:27 and take also of the tree of life, 7:3 ; 19:21 ; 24:19 ; 26:21 ; 29:27 ; 30:15 ; 32:21 ( ֗֗֗ הִגֵּה גַּם : so Est 7:9 ) Gen 48:11 ; Exod 8:28 ; 12:32 b Deut 1:37 ; 1Sam 28:20 ; 2Sam 11:12 ; 2Kin 9:27 ; Isa 7:13 +. Often before pronouns, Gen 4:4 הוּא גַם הֵבִיא וְהֶבֶל and Abel, he also brought, 20:5 וְהִיאגַֿםהִֿוא (so only here) and she herself also , 20:6 ; 27:31 הוּא גַּם וַיַּעַשׂ , 30:8 ; Deut 3:20 ; Judg 3:31 ; 6:35 ; 9:19 ; 1Sam 19:20-24 Jer 12:6 ; 48:26 etc. (compare MI 6 הא גם ויאמר ): especially in Genealogies of J (Bu Urg. 220 ) Gen 4:22 , 26 ; 10:21 ; 19:38 ; 22:20 , 24 compare Judg 8:31 . גַּם followed by pronoun also begins a sentence with emphasis in an elevated style, thou (they) also , Isa 14:10 ; Jer 12:6 (twice in verse); 48:7 ; Ezek 16:52 ; Nahum 3:11 (twice in verse). After a pronoun in an oblique case (Ges § 135 , 2) Gen 27:34 ; 1Sam 19:23 ; 2Sam 17:5 ; Jer 25:14 ; 27:7 +. וְגַם and also (more often than גַּם alone attaching a sentence) Gen 6:4 ; 14:16 ; 15:14 ; 17:16 ; 20:12 ; 24:14 , 46 ; 30:6 ; 37:7 ; 38:24 ; 42:28 ; Exod 2:19 ; 3:9 ; 4:14 ; Josh 7:11 (5 t.) 1Sam 4:17 ; 1Kin 21:19 + often; with a negative = neither Exod 5:2 ; 34:3 and elsewhere — גַּם ֗֗֗ גַּם (like et ... et ) both ... and Gen 44:16 ; 47:3 , 19 ; Num 18:3 ; Jer 51:12 ; Psa 49:3 +: גַּם ֗֗֗ גַּם ֗֗֗ גַּם Gen 24:25 ; Judg 8:22 ; Eccl 9:6 : with a negative neither ... nor Num 23:25 ; 1Sam 20:27 ; 1Kin 3:26 , and (3t.) Gen 43:8 ; Exod 4:10 ; 1Sam 28:6 . So (but seldom) גַּםוְ֗֗֗גַם Gen 24:44 ; Exod 10:25 f.; 1Sam 2:26 ; 12:14 ; 26:25 : with negative 21:9 . — N.B. In poetry independence and emphasis is sometimes given by גַּם to a new idea, where in English we should be satisfied with and: Psa 107:5 ; 137:1 ; Job 24:19 ; Cant 7:14; Lam 4:15 . 2 with stress on a particular word , even , Exod 4:9 ; Num 22:33 אוֺתְךָ גַּם even thee I had slain, and kept her alive, 2Sam 17:10 ; Jer 2:33 ; Psa 132:12 ; Prov 14:13 even in laughter the heart is sorrowful, 14:20 ; 17:28 ; 20:11 ; Ruth 2:15 ; Nehemiah 3:35; and so often after כִּי , Deut 12:31 for even their sons they burn in the fire to their gods, 1Sam 22:17 ; Isa 26:12 ; Jer 6:11 ; 12:6 ; 14:5 ; Hosea 9:12 לָהֶם כִּיגַֿםאֿוֺי for even woe is it to them when I depart from them; הֲגַם Gen 16:13 ; 1Sam 10:11-12 , = 19:24 ; 1Kin 17:20 ; Psa 78:20 ; Job 41:1 ; Est 7:8 . Other cases: — 1Sam 24:12 רְאֵה גַּם רְאֵה see, yea see ! (but Hup Qu. Job vi. רָאֹה גַּם : compare below) Psa 118:11 ; Job 2:10 נְקַבֵּל אֶתהַֿטּוֺב גַּם shall we receive good (emphatic) from God and not evil ? 21:7 ; interposed once between a substantive and adjective Gen 20:4 Gentemne etiam justam interficies? emphasizing כֹּל , Deut 28:61 ; Judg 9:49 b 1Sam 22:7 לְכֻלְּכֶם גַּםֿ to all (emphatic) of you will he give ...? 2Sam 19:31 יִקָּ֑ח אֶתהַֿכֹּל גַּם yea , the whole let him take! 46:4 ; Num 11:15 ; 16:13 ; 1Sam 1:6 . שְׁנֵיהֶם גַּם literally even both i.e. the one as well as the other (German alle beide ) is said idiomatically, Gen 27:45 ( שְׁנֵיכֶם ), Deut 22:22 ; 23:19 ; 1Sam 25:43 ( שְׁתֵּיהֶן ), Prov 17:15 ; 20:10 , 12 ; Ruth 1:5 . 3 introducing a climax , yea , especially in a rhetorical style, Gen 27:33 ; Deut 23:3 ; 23:4 ; Judg 5:4 (twice in verse); Isa 13:3 ; 14:8 ; 43:13 yea , from to-day I am the same, 44:12 רָעֵב גַּם yea , he is hungry, and has no strength, 47:3 ; 48:8 (3 t. in verse); 57:7 ; Jer 46:16 ; 48:2 ; 51:44 ; Hosea 7:9 ; Psa 41:10 ; 84:7 ; 139:12 ; Isa 66:8 אֶתבָּֿנֶיהָ צִיּוֺן גַּםיָָֽֿלְדָה, כִּיחָֿ֫לָה , Jer 5:28 ; 12:2 ; Ezek 24:5 ; Job 21:7 ; Song 8:1 : emphasizing an extreme, or aggravated, case, yea, even , Isa 49:15 yea , these may forgot, Jer 8:17 yea , the stork knoweth, etc., Isa 23:12 שָׁם גַּם even there no rest shall be for thee (so Psa 139:10 ), Isa 49:25 ; 57:6 ; Jer 23:11 b; Mal 3:15 ; Psa 84:4 . 4 expressing correspondence , especially in the matter of retribution (the גַּם correlativum ), so frequently אָנֹכִי גַּם אֲנִי, גַּם I also (on my part): — Gen 20:6 I also [as well as thyself] know that thou hast done this innocently, Josh 24:18 ; Judg 2:21 ; 1Sam 1:28 (compare Dr) 28:22 אַתָּה גַּם thou also (as I have done 28:21 ), 2Sam 12:13 ׳י also [responding to thy confession] hath removed thy sin, 2Kin 2:3 , 5 ; Isa 31:2 ; 66:3-4 ( גם ֗֗֗ גם , emphasizing the action of both parties), Jer 2:36 ; 4:12 now will I also [in correspondence with their deeds] speak judgments with them, 7:11 ; 51:49 ( גם ֗֗֗ גם ), Ezek 5:8 , 11 ; 16:43 ( וְגַם = therefore also ), 23:35 ; Hosea 4:6 because thou hast forgotten the direction of thy God, I also (on my part) will forget thy children, Psa 52:7 (thou lovest evil, etc.) יִתָּצְךָ אֵל גַּם God also (on his part) will pluck thee up, 71:22 ; 133:1 ; Prov 1:26 ; Job 7:11 ; 12:3 ; 16:4 ; so וְגַם Judg 2:3 ; Amos 4:6-7 , Micah 6:13 ; Mal 2:9 . In the apodosis (uncommon): Gen 13:16 if a man could number the dust of the earth, יִמָּנֶה זַרְעֲךָ גַּם thy seed also should be numbered, Jer 31:36-37 , 33:21 , 26 ; Zech 8:6 . The correspondence is sometimes of the nature of a climax: Gen 27:33 ; 30:8 I have wrestled, יָכֹלְתִּי גַּם (compare 1Kin 22:22 תּוּכָ֔ל וְגַם , Jer 50:24 ), Isa 66:8 . 5 connecting two ideas which express (or imply) a contradiction, גַּם acquires sometimes an adversative force (compare אַף 1 end), yet, but, though: Psa 95:9 they tried me, but also (Che) saw my work (namely of judgment), 129:2 ; Jer 6:15 = 8:12 ; Ezek 20:23 ; Eccl 4:8 , 16 ; 5:18 ; Neh 6:1 . So וְגַם Ezek 16:28 ; 20:15 ; Eccl 3:13 ; 6:7 ; Neh 5:8 . 6 כִּי גַּם (with imperfect) yea, when Lam 3:8 , even when Prov 22:6 ; yea though (stating an imagined case) Isa 1:15 ; Hosea 8:10 ; 9:16 ; Psa 23:4 (so אִם גַּם Eccl 8:17 ); also (is it) that Ruth 2:21 (see כִּי 1d ). גַם כִּי = for even (see above 2 ); = though even, although (conceding a fact) Eccl 4:14 (see De) 8:12 .
